```json
{
  "edition_title": "September 2026: Build Season Opens for Nigeria's Next Builders",
  "edition_intro": "You are not waiting for permission to matter, you are already building. This edition rounds up currently open scholarships, grants, conferences, competitions, and free certifications for ambitious young Nigerians ready to move. Read the deadlines carefully, some close within weeks, and go apply.",
  "opportunities": [
    {
      "category": "scholarships",
      "title": "Knight-Hennessy Scholars 2027 (Stanford University)",
      "summary": "Fully funded graduate study in any field at Stanford University for up to three years, covering tuition, living stipend, and travel, for future global leaders.",
      "deadline": "6 October 2026",
      "eligibility": "Applicants of any nationality applying to a full-time Stanford graduate degree program, who have completed an undergraduate degree by matriculation",
      "apply_url": "https://knight-hennessy.stanford.edu/admission",
      "body_md": "Knight-Hennessy Scholars funds up to three years of graduate study at Stanford across any discipline, medicine, law, engineering, business, education, and more, alongside a leadership development program that puts scholars from every continent in the same cohort. It is one of the largest fully endowed graduate scholarships in the world, and it does not require you to already have a Stanford admission before you apply; the two applications run concurrently.\n\nFor a Nigerian applicant with strong academic results and a track record of initiative, whether that is a startup, research, or community leadership, this is a route into one of the most resourced universities on earth without the tuition bill. The application closes 6 October 2026 at 1pm Pacific Time, and you must also submit your Stanford graduate program application by 1 December 2026 to remain eligible."
    },
    {
      "category": "scholarships",
      "title": "Mandela Rhodes Scholarship 2027 (Postgraduate Study in South Africa)",
      "summary": "Fully funded postgraduate scholarship for African students to study at a South African university while receiving structured leadership development.",
      "deadline": "14 April 2027",
      "eligibility": "African citizens under 30, completing or holding an undergraduate degree, applying for Honours or Master's study in South Africa",
      "apply_url": "https://www.mandelarhodes.org/scholarship/apply/",
      "body_md": "The Mandela Rhodes Foundation funds postgraduate study, Honours or Master's, at any South African university, and pairs it with a leadership curriculum built around Nelson Mandela's legacy: reconciliation, education, and entrepreneurship. Scholars join a pan-African network that runs well beyond graduation, with the Foundation actively investing in scholars' ventures and projects after the scholarship year ends.\n\nApplications for the 2027 intake are open now and close 14 April 2027, giving Nigerian applicants ample runway to prepare a strong application and secure a university offer. It suits graduates who want a rigorous postgraduate qualification without leaving the continent, plus a leadership credential that carries real weight across Africa's development and business sectors."
    },
    {
      "category": "grants",
      "title": "Bridge Seed Global Impact Accelerator 2026",
      "summary": "Equity-free $5,000 seed funding plus a three-month accelerator for young African founders building real businesses, no ownership given up.",
      "deadline": "Rolling",
      "eligibility": "African founders aged 18 to 35 with an early-stage venture addressing a social or economic challenge",
      "apply_url": "https://bridgeseedglobal.org/accelerator-program/",
      "body_md": "Bridge Seed Global runs a three-month accelerator for young African entrepreneurs, offering $5,000 in non-dilutive funding, meaning founders keep full ownership of their company, alongside structured coaching in business modelling, financial planning, and investment readiness. The program also connects founders directly to mentors and investor networks beyond the cohort itself.\n\nApplications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so there is no fixed closing date, but earlier submissions get first access to interview slots and cohort spots. For a young Nigerian building in agriculture, health, education, or climate, this is a rare grant that does not ask for equity or a track record you don't yet have, just a real problem and a credible plan to solve it."
    },
    {
      "category": "conferences",
      "title": "Moonshot by TechCabal 2026",
      "summary": "Africa's fastest-growing tech conference returns to Lagos for two days of deal rooms, founder programming, and 6,000+ attendees from across the continent.",
      "deadline": "28 October 2026",
      "eligibility": "Open to founders, builders, investors, and tech professionals; register online for a pass",
      "apply_url": "https://moonshot.techcabal.com/",
      "body_md": "Moonshot is TechCabal's flagship conference, now in its fourth year, held at the National Theatre in Lagos on 28 and 29 October 2026 under the theme 'Courage & Conviction, Building for a New World.' It draws thousands of founders, operators, and investors from across Africa for two days of matchmaking rooms, deal sessions, workshops, and an end-of-conference mixer built for real networking, not just panels.\n\nFor a young Nigerian founder or operator, this is one of the highest-density rooms of African tech talent and capital you can walk into in a single week. Registration is open now through the official site, with ticket tiers available; go early, since side events and workshops around the main conference fill up fast."
    },
    {
      "category": "conferences",
      "title": "Digital Nigeria International Conference, Exhibition and Awards (DNICE) 2026",
      "summary": "A three-day government-backed gathering in Abuja on Nigeria's digital economy, with a dedicated student registration tier and virtual attendance option.",
      "deadline": "10 November 2026",
      "eligibility": "Open to students, innovators, entrepreneurs, and policy professionals; register online, virtual access available",
      "apply_url": "https://digitalnigeria.gov.ng/digital/register",
      "body_md": "DNICE brings policymakers, technology companies, and young innovators together in Abuja from 10 to 12 November 2026 to look at where Nigeria's digital economy is headed, covering everything from broadband policy to AI adoption and digital skills. It is organized under Nigeria's Digital Economy agenda, which means the conversations in the room directly shape the policy and funding environment young tech builders operate in.\n\nA student registration tier and virtual access option make this one of the more accessible policy-facing conferences on the calendar, useful if you want visibility with government and industry decision-makers without needing a corporate sponsor to get you in the door. Register through the official portal ahead of the event."
    },
    {
      "category": "competitions",
      "title": "WEMA Bank Hackaholics 7.0",
      "summary": "A free, pan-African hackathon and startup pitch competition with a N150 million prize pool across hackathon, startup pitch, and social impact tracks.",
      "deadline": "Rolling",
      "eligibility": "Open to developers, designers, product thinkers, and early-stage startup founders across Africa; free to enter",
      "apply_url": "https://hackaholics.wemabank.com/",
      "body_md": "Hackaholics 7.0 is Wema Bank's annual innovation competition, expanded this year to three tracks: a timed hackathon for developers and designers, a startup pitch track for founders with a live product, and a new social impact track for solutions to community-level problems. The prize pool has grown to N150 million, alongside mentorship and partnership opportunities with the bank's innovation arm.\n\nEntry is completely free, and applications are open now through the official portal with no announced closing date yet, so early applicants get first access to the national pitch tour stops. This is a solid option for a young Nigerian with a working prototype or a sharp idea who wants funding and visibility without giving up equity to enter."
    },
    {
      "category": "certifications",
      "title": "AWS Student Rewards on AWS Builder Center",
      "summary": "Free 12 months of premium AWS Skill Builder training, AWS credits, and a certification exam voucher for verified students, part of a $500M AWS investment.",
      "deadline": "Rolling",
      "eligibility": "University students aged 18+ who verify enrollment through SheerID on AWS Builder Center",
      "apply_url": "https://builder.aws.com/student-rewards",
      "body_md": "AWS launched Student Rewards on its Builder Center platform to give verified students a fast path into cloud and AI skills: 12 months of premium Skill Builder access covering 900+ courses and hands-on labs, plus a $100 certification exam voucher and AWS credits, a package worth over $579 per student. Verification is quick, done through SheerID inside Builder Center, with most approvals completing within minutes.\n\nFor a Nigerian student aiming at an AWS certification without the usual exam fee barrier, this is straightforward: verify your student status, build out your Builder Center profile, and the training access unlocks immediately, with the certification voucher earned as you engage on the platform. There is no application deadline, it is an ongoing program, so the earlier you start, the more of the 12-month access window you get to use."
    }
  ]
}
```
